notes.title: Our Third Game - Lust For Lucre!
notes.notes:
Howdy, you lusty adventurers you!

We've been working on our third game, Lust For Lucre, for a while now, and finally have released the steam page for the game. If this seems familiar, we were initially set to release this game several years ago, but the game was shelved, but we've revived it and are actively working on it again.

The game is a much different kind of game from Drumpf or Drumpf 2, and is generally apolitical in nature, but will instead be focused on your character exploring a fantasy land, romancing the 14 maidens of the land, [i][b]gaining their tokens of affection[/b][/i], and stripping a whole bunch of saucy monsters.

You can check it out here if you are interested!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079290/Lust_For_Lucre/]Lust For Lucre | Wishlist Today![/url]
